rank_note: Does not rewrite VIA_Policy_Laws. This file is the process SSOT for US macro series.
owner: FRED for US official series. yfinance may cross-check Treasury yields only. AKShare may cross-check, never replace FRED.
intake: references/intake macro_ssot.json is not edited. New ids land in VDF_USMacro_Tree_v0100.json first.
rules: Same fred_id is one series. A second name is a synonym, not a new row.
Monthly, quarterly, and annual are frequencies, not synonyms. Compare them only after the stated aggregation.
A finer child must name its parent code. A child is not a synonym of the parent.
No probe, no add. HTTP 400 is PARKED, not a live series.
yfinance tickers ^IRX ^FVX ^TNX ^TYX overlap DGS3MO DGS5 DGS10 DGS30. FRED owns the value.
AKShare is a cross-check lane. A function name is recorded only after one successful call.
Synonym updates go to the central synonym book only when two sources agree on the overlap window.
